article.title: Amendments of Act 1 of 1944.
article.content:
246Amendments of Act 1 of 1944.

Section 246  ·  Part V  ·  page 154 of the Act
The Central Excise Act, 1944 shall be amended in the manner specified in the Second Schedule.
